propositions: The store-wide compaction sweep performs one git log walk per ticket while holding the global write lock, causing multi-minute stalls that block all writers.

The sweep's `_build_authorship_ledger` calls `build_ticket_position_commit_map` per ticket inside the locked section, when a position-keyed map built once per sweep before taking any lock would amortize the history walk.
The sweep stages uncommitted event files from concurrent writers via unscoped `git add -A`, committing them under the compaction message instead of isolating only folded paths.
The sweep never re-probes `write_lock_is_busy` between tickets, so writers arriving after the sweep starts must wait for the entire run to complete.
The fix hoists the one-pass position-keyed history walk out of the lock, threads it through per-ticket folds, scopes staging to folded paths, and re-probes mid-run to yield when writers arrive.
